records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 was west bound on north 10th preparing to turn left onto south bound north willis. she had to wait for some cars to pass by traveling east bound before she could turn. as she proceeded into her turn she stated that unit 2, a pedestrian, stepped off the west curb of [roadway] going east. unit 1 struck unit 2. when spoke to by officers at the scene including myself, unit 2 admitted that he was not in the actual crosswalk. he pointed to his location to an officer of where he was crossing. he also told me that the crossing symbol light had a red solid stop hand and would never change to the walk symbol. i asked him if he had pressed the button to get the light to change so he could have the right of way and he stated he never pressed the button. this would cause the walk symbol to never appear and he would not have the right of way. autumn (witness) is the only witness that places the pedestrian in the crosswalk. the others either stated he was not or was ""very close"". no witness could give information of what the crosswalk symbol actually was as they were not in a position to see it or did not look. while on scene i watched the light pattern and the hand signal never changed until i pushed the button for east bound travel indicating it was not an automatic walk symbol at this time. unit 2 failed to yield the right of way to the vehicle, unit 1. aoi: 28' s of s curb of north 10th and 5' e of w curb of north willis. about 15' s of s edge of crosswalk witnesses: carla jackson (325)660-1885; sandra vinson (325)513-0503; shellie lombardo (979)219-0711; autumn thesing (979)219-0711 (daughter of shellie); marcy loza (325)439-9013

(witnesses: tina mckenna [phone], stacy auston [phone], benjamin lozano [phone]). supplement: i completed my investigative findings in this case. i determined that sammy maxwell operated a 2014 toyota rav4 in the [roadway]. this was determined by the witness statements at the crash scene and the vehicle/roadway evidence that was documented at the scene. i determined that maxwell put his vehicle in reverse and exited his vehicle. maxwell was knocked down and run over by the vehicle that he left in reverse. this was determined by the witness statements at the crash scene, and the nature of maxwell injuries documented in the autopsy report. i was also able to determine that maxwell was not intoxicated or under the influence of narcotics at the time of the crash. this was determined by the harris county institute of forensic science who completed an autopsy and laboratory testing. the testing showed that maxwell did not have the presence of alcohol or drugs in his system. i was able to determine that maxwell's cause and manner of death was a accident due to blunt force injuries with atherosclerotic and hypertensive cardiovascular disease, and dementia that contributed to his death. this was determined by the harris county institute of forensic science who completed an autopsy and laboratory testing on maxwell. the investigation is complete in this case. maxwell's actions caused him to be the sole contributing factor to this crash, and cause of his death.
